ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: harmony
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: End the feuds in the colony, so there are no two colonists who can't stand each other. Separate bedrooms, parties and time apart all help.

plain.li: Some of us haven't spoken to each other in weeks, and it's getting worse. I want the feuds settled.
Every dinner is two people glaring at each other over the stew. We need to settle this before it comes to blows.
[afterraid] We fought side by side yesterday. Today the same two people won't pass the salt.

warm.li: We're all we've got out here. Families fight, but they make up afterward, and I'd like us to.

blunt.li: If you hate someone at this table, knock it off. That's my whole proposal.

cheerful.li: A group hug, mandatory, especially for the grumpy ones!

gloomy.li: We're too few to be enemies. One day it'll come down to one of us saving another, and they'll hesitate.

cold.li: Two people who hate each other cost us more work than one person with a broken leg.

plain.li: No one's at anyone's throat for once. It's almost suspicious.

warm.li: Look at them all laughing at the same table.

cheerful.li: Not a single spoon thrown at dinner tonight!

cold.li: No more feuds. I expect the work to go faster by the end of the week.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a council worth trusting
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Raise the colony's trust in the council to 30 by granting wishes, keeping promises and heeding petitions. Colonists work better for a council they trust.

plain.li: People have stopped bringing anything to the council. I don't think that's because they're content.
Keep a few promises. Grant a few wishes. Let people believe it's worth speaking up again.
[bitter] Nobody I talk to trusts this council. Change that, or stop calling it one.

warm.li: People should be able to walk into a meeting with a complaint and walk out with an answer.

blunt.li: You want people to follow the council? Earn it.

cheerful.li: Imagine a council people actually like! The meetings could even be short.

gloomy.li: Once people stop trusting the council, they don't start again easily. We're close to that.

cold.li: A trusted council gets better work out of every colonist, and right now we aren't trusted.

plain.li: People bring their problems to the council again. That's the job.

warm.li: Somebody brought me a petition today with a flower tucked into it.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: clean living
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Get every colonist through withdrawal until no one is addicted to anything. It takes a strict drug policy and some patience.

plain.li: Some of us start the day shaking. That's not a way to live, and it's not a way to fight a raid.
Lock the stuff away and ride out the withdrawals together. In a season, no one will need it.
[trait:Teetotaler] I've watched what it does to people. I'd like to stop watching.

warm.li: I want every one of you free of it, and I don't want anyone judged for it.

blunt.li: Our guards are shaking on the wall, and not from the cold. Fix it.

cheerful.li: Clear heads all round, and nothing stronger than water!

gloomy.li: The withdrawals will be ugly. The alternative is worse, and slower.

cold.li: Withdrawal costs us one slow season. Addiction costs us that every season.

plain.li: No one shaking at breakfast, and no bottles hidden under the beds.

warm.li: Every one of them made it through. Some nights I wasn't sure they would.

gloomy.li: They're through it. Keep the cupboard locked anyway.
